units.source_text: 火柴燃剩一丁点火星，我总也放心不下，

en.t: When the match had burned down to a tiny spark, I still could not feel at ease,

units.source_text: 就像有一天在妙心寺看见的那个学生一样，

en.t: just like that student I had once seen at Myoshinji,

units.source_text: 一心在把这点火星踩灭，这是异乎寻常的。

en.t: single-mindedly trying to stamp out that little spark; it was extraordinary.

units.source_text: 接着，我又点燃一根新的火柴。

en.t: Then I lit another new match.

units.source_text: 我经过六角经堂和三尊像前，来到了香资箱前，

en.t: I passed before the hexagonal sutra hall and the three statues, and came to the offertory box,

units.source_text: 看见香资箱上方是一排排的横木条，以便人们投入香资。

en.t: where I saw rows of horizontal wooden slats above it, arranged so that people could drop in their offerings.

units.source_text: 这些横木条的影子随着火苗的摇晃，恍如银波在荡漾。

en.t: The shadows of these slats swayed with the flame, like rippling waves of silver.

units.source_text: 香资箱后面，安置着一首届国宝的鹿苑院殿道义足利义满的木橡。

en.t: Behind the offertory box stood the wooden image of Rokuon-in-dono Dogi, Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, the first object designated a National Treasure.

units.source_text: 那是一等身着法衣的坐像，衣袖左右拖得很长，

en.t: It was a life-sized seated figure in Buddhist robes, with sleeves trailing long to either side,
holding something in its right hand and turning it sideways toward the left hand.

units.source_text: 双眼睁开，小脑袋剃光，脖颈在法衣领子里。

en.t: Its eyes were open, its small head was shaved, and its neck was tucked into the collar of the robe.

units.source_text: 它的眼睛在火苗的映照下闪闪发光。

en.t: Its eyes glittered in the light of the flame.

units.source_text: 看起来这算小偶像甚是凄惨，

en.t: This small idol seemed terribly pitiful,

units.source_text: 尽管它镇坐在自己兴建的宅邸的一角，然而对于遥远的昔日的统治却全然断念了。

en.t: for although it sat enthroned in a corner of the mansion it had built, it had wholly renounced its rule from the distant past.
